criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Only claims of reading Asner brief, bleaching research and STK tutorials. No results, figures, calculations or simulations shown. Minor work only, with major orbit error, insufficient to show on-track technical progress.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Well-written with headings and consistent formatting, readable style. Gantt has no number/caption/label, references are bare URLs not proper citation, software choice not headed, so below professional Accomplished.

evidence.quote: Coral reefs harbour some of the most diverse species

technical_issues.issue: States 'geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km' - incorrect: GEO is ~35786 km; 600 km is LEO and cannot remain fixed above reef, GEO must be equatorial.
Proposes graveyard orbit / leave in place for 600 km LEO end-of-life; graveyard is GEO practice, LEO should de-orbit per debris guidelines.

overall: Good reef-monitoring rationale with feasible schedule but weak technical evidence and critical orbit misconception. Needs explicit software statement, sources list, and corrected orbit analysis with early results.

feedback.summary: You presented a clear reef-monitoring need with SST/thermal functions for scientists and a feasible Wk2-Wk10 plan, but you need to correct your orbit concept, add explicit software/sources, and show early technical results with proper presentation to move up.
next_steps: Correct your 600 km geostationary claim in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress to LEO versus ~35786 km equatorial GEO and change graveyard to LEO de-orbit disposal.
Add formal quantified goals/requirements, an explicit software statement, a future sources list, and contingency provision to your Wk2-Wk10 Gantt plan.
Include early STK calculations/figures with numbered captions and proper in-text citations to show on-track technical progress.

criteria.C2: You did well in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress and Image 1 with a feasible Wk2-Wk10 Gantt covering launch, orbit, ground, comms and STK. To reach Accomplished, explain why the plan fits your mission narrative and add contingency provision plus explicit future information sources and software.
criteria.C3: You noted reading and STK tutorials 1-4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, but showed no results or calculations. To reach Adequate, correct your 600 km geostationary and graveyard errors to LEO de-orbit and include early figures/calculations with brief interpretation.
criteria.C4: You wrote well with clear headings and consistent formatting from Coral reefs harbour... To reach Accomplished, add a number/caption to your Image 1 Gantt, head your software choice, and use proper in-text citations instead of bare URLs.
